_comment: Tunable demo rules. Keep every threshold here so the pitch can say 'configurable' and mean it.

sibling_normal_tolerance.note: Sibling buildings on the same distributor must be inside these bounds to route BUILDING_SIDE.

severity.High: any permissible-limit breach OR coliform present OR 5+ buildings affected

forecast.method: first-order decay C_out = C_in * exp(-k * travel_time); k grows with pipe age and smaller diameter

anomaly.method: z-score against the same hour on previous days (time-of-day baseline)

escalation.note: Demo timer, not a real SLA.
